5900
OFFICIAL GAZETTE
as "Rizal," comprising the eastern portion of the munic-
ipality of Dapitan, more particularly described and bounded
On the north by the limit of the municipal waters which
the municipality of Rizal shall have pursuant to section
2321 of the kevised Administrative Code;
On the east by the Zamboanga-Qccidental Misamis prov-
incial boundary;
On the south by the present boundary line of Dapitan
and Dipolog; and
On the west by a straight line starting from M.B.M. No.
3, located at the intersection of longitude 123° 30° E. and
latitude 8° 25' N., established by Survey Party No. 17-B of
the Bureau of Lands, rumming 4° 15' E. to Calubi point at.
the intersection of longitude 123° 31' E. and latitude
8° 38' N. (Reference used: map of proposed municipality
of Rizal, Province of Zamboanga: Scale 1:10.000 submitted
by the office of the District Engineer.)
The municipality of Rizal, as herein organized, contains
the following barrios: New Tolon, which shall be the
seat of the municipal government, Mapang, Bongbongan,
Tuayon, Sipaon, New Carcar, Singaran, Sacro, Maroc,
Mitemos, Nanca-an, Tolon, Marapong Diot, Balatacan,
Damasing, Sibaca, Nasipang, Mabunao and Nanka.
The municipality of Dapitan shall have its present
territory minus the portion thereof included in the munic-
ipality of Rizal.
The municipality of Rizal shall begin to exist upon the
appointment and qualification of the municipal mayor,
the vice-mavor and a majority of the councilors thereof.
Done in the City of Manila, this 21st day of December,
in the vear of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty, and
of the Independence of the Philippines, the fifth.
ELPIDIO QUIFINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
TEODORO EVANGELISTA
Executive Secretary
